long_biography.plain_text:
Competitive sailing has made William Mathews ‘Matt’ Brooks an advocate for maritime preservation. With his wife, Pam Rorke Levy, he restored and campaigned classic racing boats through major ocean contests. The work earned Cruising Club of America recognition, and Brooks later became chair emeritus of the NYYC Foundation.

Brooks extended that maritime commitment into education and public service. IYRS named him its 2016 Wave Award recipient for sustained support of the trades school, where he later became a trustee emeritus. California also appointed him to the San Francisco Bay pilot commission. His contribution drew on an unusual combination of sailing, aviation and legal experience.
